verses.text: For the choir director. A Psalm of David. How long, O LORD? Will You forget me forever? How long will You hide Your face from me?
verses.textZh: （大衛的詩，交與伶長。）耶和華啊，你忘記我要到幾時呢？要到永遠麼？你掩面不顧我要到幾時呢？

verses.text: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, [Having] sorrow in my heart all the day? How long will my enemy be exalted over me?
verses.textZh: 我心裡籌算，終日愁苦，要到幾時呢？我的仇敵升高壓制我，要到幾時呢？

verses.text: Consider [and] answer me, O LORD my God; Enlighten my eyes, or I will sleep the [sleep of] death,
verses.textZh: 耶和華─我的神啊，求你看顧我，應允我！使我眼目光明，免得我沉睡至死；

verses.text: And my enemy will say, 'I have overcome him,' [And] my adversaries will rejoice when I am shaken.
verses.textZh: 免得我的仇敵說：我勝了他；免得我的敵人在我搖動的時候喜樂。

verses.text: But I have trusted in Your lovingkindness; My heart shall rejoice in Your salvation.
verses.textZh: 但我倚靠你的慈愛；我的心因你的救恩快樂。

verses.text: I will sing to the LORD, Because He has dealt bountifully with me.
verses.textZh: 我要向耶和華歌唱，因他用厚恩待我。
